name: [ATTACK TITAN] Attack on Shenanigans
desc:
MADE BY A SOLO DEV

"attack on... what?"

M1 - melee, ranged combo
1,2,3,4 - skills
Q - dash/left hook
E - right hook
F - block (unsheathe before using)
R - special
G - awaken

combat and destruction mainly based off jujutsu shenanigans

expect lots of bugs and performance issues
